new = '''def stats(model, obs, maxlag=72):
    def one(m, o):
        k = np.isfinite(m) & np.isfinite(o)
        d = m[k] - o[k]
        return int(k.sum()), float(np.corrcoef(m[k], o[k])[0, 1]), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(d ** 2))), float(d.mean())
    n, r, rmse, bias = one(model, obs)
    lags = np.arange(-maxlag, maxlag + 1, 3)
    rl = [one(np.roll(model, -L), obs)[1] if L else r for L in lags]
    j = int(np.nanargmax(rl))
    late = np.arange(model.size) >= 12 * 24
    return dict(n=n, r=r, rmse_kms=rmse, bias_kms=bias, best_lag_h=int(lags[j]), r_best_lag=float(rl[j]),
                rmse_after_nov22_kms=one(np.where(late, model, np.nan), obs)[2], r_after_nov22=one(np.where(late, model, np.nan), obs)[1])


'''
s = s.replace(old, new)
open('qc.py', 'w').write(s)
